import re, subprocess, statistics
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path("/Users/sinchunyeung/.treehouse/simplification-of-trajectory-streams-bec452/2/simplification-of-trajectory-streams")
BASE = Path("/tmp/simplify-iter4-baseline")
NEW = REPO / "build-release" / "simplify"
CORE_RE = re.compile(r"SIMPLIFY_CORE_MS:\s*([\d.]+)")

pairs = [
    (10, 0.25, 400),
    (10, 0.5, 200),
    (10, 299.0, 1.0),
    (1, 299.0, 1.0),
    (10, 2.0, 100),
    (1, 0.25, 400),
    (5, 1.0, 200),
]

def core_ms(bin_path, idv, eps, delta):
    cmd = [str(bin_path), "--in", str(idv), "-e", str(eps), "-d", str(delta)]
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(proc.stderr[-500:])
    m = CORE_RE.search(proc.stderr)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("no core ms\n" + proc.stderr[-500:])
    return float(m.group(1))

repeats = 7
print(f"{'id':>3} {'eps':>6} {'delta':>6}  {'base_med':>10} {'new_med':>10} {'ratio':>7}  (n={repeats} interleaved)")
for idv, eps, delta in pairs:
    base, new = [], []
    for _ in range(repeats):
        base.append(core_ms(BASE, idv, eps, delta))
        new.append(core_ms(NEW, idv, eps, delta))
    bm, nm = statistics.median(base), statistics.median(new)
    print(f"{idv:3d} {eps:6.2f} {delta:6.1f}  {bm:10.3f} {nm:10.3f} {nm/bm:7.3f}  base={min(base):.2f}..{max(base):.2f} new={min(new):.2f}..{max(new):.2f}")
